sources.title: Focus on Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
sources.publisher: National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke
sources.scope: ALS biology, therapeutic targets, and current research context
sources.limitations: Research overview; not a clinical practice guideline or patient-specific recommendation.

sources.title: Multiple Sclerosis: Hope Through Research
sources.publisher: National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke
sources.scope: MS diagnosis, clinical assessment, MRI, CSF, evoked potentials, and research
sources.limitations: General research overview; individual diagnosis requires clinical criteria and exclusion of alternatives.

sources.title: Digital twin for neurological conditions: a systematic scoping review
sources.scope: 36 neurological digital-twin studies; data sources, modeling, clinical applications, validation maturity
sources.limitations: The review reports mostly proof-of-concept or retrospective work, limited external validation, and no randomized controlled trials identified in its search.

sources.title: Clinical Decision Support Software Guidance for Industry and Food and Drug Administration Staff
sources.scope: Regulatory distinctions among clinical decision support and device software functions
sources.limitations: Guidance is not a substitute for product-specific regulatory analysis.

sources.title: Causal inference and digital twins: a roadmap for the future of clinical trials
sources.scope: Causal inference and digital twins for treatment-effect heterogeneity, transportability, and trial design
sources.limitations: Roadmap/review; proposed potential is not proof of clinical effectiveness.
